scope: Read-only official source checks for exactly two candidate answers. No browser or streaming execution.

sources.title: WHATWG Fetch Standard: CORS protocol and credentials; CORS check
verifiedPoints: With credentials mode include, wildcard Access-Control-Allow-Origin does not satisfy the CORS check; exact origin and byte-case-sensitive true credentials value are required.
CORS handles browser cross-origin response sharing, and the preflight/actual-response phases are distinct.
sources.boundary: The canonical URL initially timed out; the same official page was successfully retrieved via the search-result URL. No third-party tutorial is used as the normative source.

sources.title: Spring Framework: CORS
verifiedPoints: Credentialed origins require a trusted policy; allowed-origin wildcard differs from allowed/exposed-header behavior.
Spring handles preflight and actual requests and may combine local/global configuration.
sources.boundary: General configuration contract only; no proposed version-specific configuration code or claim that all Spring wildcard settings behave identically.

sources.title: Spring Security: CORS
verifiedPoints: CORS handling must precede an authentication rejection caused by the ordinary preflight having no login cookie.
sources.boundary: Does not exempt real protected requests from authentication or authorization; current reference APIs are not claimed to be the frozen project configuration.

sources.title: Spring Framework 6.2.19: Asynchronous Requests
sections: Async Spring MVC compared to WebFlux
verifiedPoints: Servlet async permits the original request/filter thread to exit while the response remains open.
SseEmitter supports streaming; Spring MVC response writes remain blocking.
The configured AsyncTaskExecutor discussion for reactive return values must not be generalized to every direct application SseEmitter.send call.
sources.boundary: Conceptual documentation, not a claim of verified project runtime dependencies, capacity or execution.

sources.title: Spring Framework v6.1.14: ResponseBodyEmitterReturnValueHandler
verifiedPoints: The injected executor is passed to ReactiveTypeHandler for reactive values.
A direct ResponseBodyEmitter/SseEmitter takes a distinct branch; its send handler writes through a message converter and flushes directly.
sources.boundary: Read-only official tagged source check. It supports distinguishing the business send executor from reactiveTaskExecutor terminology; it does not establish an arbitrary application bean name or actual NoteWeave runtime execution.

sources.title: WHATWG HTML Living Standard: Server-sent events
verifiedPoints: Retryable interruption/normal EOF may reestablish an EventSource connection; retry sets a reconnection delay and the browser may wait longer.
A nonempty maintained event ID is sent as Last-Event-ID on reconnection.
close(), HTTP 204 and fail-the-connection conditions stop native reconnection. Business event names or [DONE] are not native stop commands.
sources.boundary: Replay retention, run ownership, continuous business application and deduplication are application contracts supported by the fully read existing ai-agent-7#6 answer, not guarantees conferred by EventSource.
